name: Dr Agarwal's Eye Hospital Ltd
tagline: High-growth eye care chain with 149+ hospitals, expanding aggressively at 13% same-store sales growth; strong margins and execution credibility under founder Mukul Agarwal
business_overview: Dr Agarwal's Eye Hospital Ltd (listed entity, 71.75% owned by parent Dr Agarwals Health Care Ltd) operates a chain of eye care facilities with a hub-and-spoke model: 149 hospitals/centers as of June 2023 across domestic (Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Punjab, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, West Bengal) and international (Africa) markets. Key service lines: Cataract surgery (80%+ of revenue), Glaucoma, Laser Correction, Cornea/Refractive, Retina. Recent expansion targets 300+ centers domestically + 100 primary clinics in tier 2-3 towns + 10+ new African centers (Kenya, Zambia, Tanzania). Parent raised Rs 1,650 Cr funding in 2022-23 (TPG Growth + Temasek) for expansion.

growth_trajectory.pat_cagr_fy24_fy28: 20-25% (profit growth outpacing revenue due to operating leverage)

management_quality.founder_track_record: Mukul Agarwal: Founder of Dr Agarwals Health Care (parent). Built brand from single clinic (1957) to 150+ hospital network over 6+ decades. Known for clinical excellence and capital discipline.
management_quality.capex_strategy: Aggressive growth: +33 centers FY23, +10 Q1 FY24, targeting 150+ new centers by FY26-27. Funded by TPG/Temasek equity (Rs 1,650 Cr raised 2022-23) + internal cash flow + planned Rs 200 Cr debt.
management_quality.execution_credibility: Strong. Delivered 33 centers in FY23 as planned; on track for 40-50/year through next 3 years. Margin improvement 18% (FY19) to 27% (FY20) shows leverage.

community_signal.consensus_view: Bullish. Recognized as underappreciated growth story with founder + strategic capital partners.

deep_dive.summary: High-conviction growth play in India's underpenetrated eye-care market, led by founder with 60+ years clinical credibility and backed by strategic capital (TPG/Temasek). At P/E 27, fairly valued for 20%+ PAT compounder. Catalysts: Q2-Q3 FY27 same-store sales confirmation, new center profitability ramps, parent dividend signal.
bull_case: Founder + strategic capital credibility and professional execution
Demographic tailwinds: Aging population (60+) with growing affluence
Same-store sales durable at 13% with doctor hiring and clinic-to-surgical funnel
Geographic TAM expansion: Tier-2/3 penetration and Africa ramp
bear_case: Valuation stretched at P/E 27 vs 10-12% PAT growth pricing assumption
Macro sensitivity on elective surgery demand
Lease renewal risk on 149 leasehold centers
Key-man risk: Mukul Agarwal age and lack of succession planning
Competitive intensity from Apollo, Max, Artemis in tier-2/3 markets

verdict_headline: High-conviction growth compounder; founder-led, fairly valued, multi-year catalyst pipeline
